governance.canonical_identity: One physical site, one Place ID; independent nearby religious locations keep separate IDs. Name matching and institutional association do not establish physical identity.
governance.major_priority: Worldwide ecclesiastical/devotional prominence; core sites must not be penalised merely because an automatic research label marked them Strong or Review.
governance.source_policy: Nomination from four existing curated discovery catalogues is adequate; release requires original site/custodian identity source and a defensible site pin.
governance.editorial_status: A site may be pilgrimage-worthy while apparition supernatural character remains unconfirmed, contested or rejected; encode distinct status.
governance.customs_policy: Do not discard SOT-07/SOT-07G evidence. Recommend removing standalone Customs Atlas map from navigation after content owners absorb practices in Calendar, Novenas, PRAY or Catholic Life & Traditions. No UI or data deletion in this review.
